name: shipit
description: Spec-driven development for any repo. `init` detects your stack, commands, layers and tests from evidence; `task` turns a need into a tracker ticket or an epic; `plan` writes a contract in your checkout (parallel worktrees are opt-in); `implement` executes and verifies it; `handoff` is the only skill with side effects, and `handoff.allow` in your config says which: branch, commit, push and the PR body by default — tracker comments, status moves, thread replies and issue creation are opt-in.
